management_steps.details: Oral formulation (alpha 1 and non-selective beta blocker).

Starting dose: 3.125 mg twice daily. Increase dose at two-weekly intervals by doubling daily dose until maximum of 25 mg twice daily, if tolerated. If > 85 kg and target heart rate not achieved, titrate to maximum of 50 mg twice daily, if tolerated.
Doctor initiated. If not tolerated (worsening CCF), reduce to previously tolerated dose. Up-titration may take several months. If discontinued > 14 days, reinstate therapy from starting dose.
